response.sql: WITH avg_qualifying AS (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) as avg_count FROM qualifying), driver_qualifying_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as qualifying_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId) SELECT dgc.driverId, dgc.qualifying_count, dgc.qualifying_count / aq.avg_count as ratio FROM driver_qualifying_counts dgc CROSS JOIN avg_qualifying aq ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
